_about: One track segment of the 1:5 prototype: every part, its dimensions in mm at model size, and whether it is bought or made. Source of truth for the drawings in this folder. Coordinates: x along the segment from the rear axle (0) to the front axle (225); y up from the axle centre line; z across from the vehicle's centre line, one side only (the other side mirrors).

layout_decision.summary: The two segments share the middle axle. Per side, from the vehicle centre line outwards: box (to 40; it must stop at 37 near the middle axle to leave room for the 3 mm hinge sector gear on the front plate's inboard face) | front segment plate 41-48 | front track lane 49-69 (the bought pulley is 20 mm over its flanges), its pulley hub 69-76 | rear track lane 77-97, its hub 97-104 | rear segment plate 105-112. So the front segment's plates are inboard and the rear segment's outboard (the top-view slide shows them the other way round and 1:5-scaled plates; this layout allows for the real pulley hubs and flanges).
layout_decision.all_pulleys_fixed_to_axles: Every pulley is set-screwed to its axle; the axles turn in bearings in the plates. The drive motor turns the middle axle (a sprocket between the two front plates, inside the box), so both segments' tracks are driven.
layout_decision.hinge: The front segment turns about the middle axle on its plate bearings. The hinge sector gear bolts to the rear end of each front plate; the pinion sits on the box. Those parts are outside this drawing set.
layout_decision.box_attachment: Rear segment to box: 2 x M4 threaded rod (238) through the rear plates and the box walls, 4 nuts + 4 washers. Front segment to box: only through the middle axle (hinge) and the sector gear / pinion on the hinge cross shaft; nothing else is bolted, so it can swing.

track.name: Track
track.process: 3D print, TPU 95A, upright as a ring, 0.2 mm layers, 100% infill, no supports
track.why_these_cleats: ES1 steps are 35 x 50 mm at 1:5, so their edges are 61.03 mm apart along the slope; 5 cleats at 12.222 mm = 61.11 mm, so every step edge under the track sits in a gap between two cleats.

pulley.name: Timing pulley, HTD 5M, 20 teeth
pulley.spec_to_order: HTD 5M, 20 teeth, for 15 mm belt, 8 mm bore, flanges both sides, set-screw hub
pulley.stand_in_file: stl/stand_in_pulley_20T_PLA_test_only.stl (PLA copy for fit tests only)
pulley.set_screw: M3 in the stand-in; bought pulleys usually M4, 2 off
pulley.note: Flange and hub sizes are the stand-in's; check the vendor drawing, the ones that matter are 20T HTD 5M, 15 mm belt, 8 mm bore.

axle.name: Axle, 8 mm steel rod
axle.vendor: MISUMI Singapore 8 mm linear shaft, or spare 8 mm rod from the Design Lab (EA-03-04)
axle.tolerance: h7 (fits 608 bearings and 8 mm pulley bores)
axle.flats: File a 0.5 mm deep flat, 10 mm long, under each pulley set screw and under the drive sprocket on the middle axle
axle.note: Lengths follow the layout: the rear and middle axles reach the outboard rear plates (z 112 each side, plus 3 mm proud); the front axle only reaches the front pulley hubs (z 76). Order unhardened rod: hardened shafts (56-64 HRC) cannot be filed for the flats.

bearing.name: Ball bearing 608ZZ
bearing.vendor: Wheeler Mectrade / SKF distributor (approved vendor list), or any 608ZZ
bearing.note: Pressed into a 22.2 mm pocket in each printed plate (2 per plate, 8 in all) plus 2 for the hinge cross shaft. Replaces the KFL08 flange blocks on the quotation slide: a KFL08 housing is 48 x 26 x 12 mm, far too big to fit between the box and the track lanes at 1:5, and costs more.
bearing.alternative: KFL08 flange block (48 x 26 mm, 12 mm thick, 2 x M4): only if the plates end up laser-cut and the layout is widened by 12 mm per side.

side_plate.name: Side plate with slide rail
side_plate.process: 3D print, PETG, lying on its plate face, 0.2 mm layers, 4 walls, 30% infill, no supports

plate.shape: a 225 mm bar from 12 below to 33 above the axle line, with R20 semicircular ends centred 10.5 mm above each axle (half way up the plate), plus an R14.5 boss round each bearing pocket (so the pocket wall is 3.4 mm; the boss reaches 14.5 below the axle, inside the pulley's radius)

bearing_pockets.note: through pockets; 0.2 mm larger than the 608 so it presses in; the R14.5 boss gives the 3.4 mm wall

rail.note: The lower run's tooth tips ride on it (they are 13.344 below the axle). It is joined to the plate's bottom edge by a web from 12.0 to 17.34 below the axle.

rail_offset.front_plate: rail centred under the lane: z 50 to 68 (plate at 41 to 48, web z 41 to 50)
rail_offset.rear_plate: rail inboard of the plate under the outer lane: z 78 to 96 (plate at 105 to 112), joined by a 9 mm web (z 96 to 105) that passes under the pulley hub (the hub is 9 above the web top)

cross_bar_holes.note: M4 threaded rod with printed spacers ties the two plates of a segment; at 28 above the axle the 10 mm spacer clears the upper run's cleat tips (19.74) by 3.3 mm

side_plate.front_plate_extra: the rear end (around the middle axle) carries the hinge sector gear: 3 x M3 holes on a 17 mm radius at 50, 90 and 130 degrees from the forward direction
side_plate.rear_plate_extra: the box is held by the two rear cross-bar rods themselves: each M4 rod runs plate - 65 spacer - box wall - box wall - 65 spacer - plate with a nut and washer at each end, so the box needs two 4.5 mm holes through each wall at x = 60 and 200 from the rear axle, 28 above the axle line. No separate box bolts.

sector_bolts.note: front plates only, round the middle-axle pocket (the front segment's rear end); the 3 mm sector gear sits on the inboard face, z 38 to 41, with M3 x 14 bolts and nuts

side_plate.print_note: 265 x 50 mm footprint printed flat: needs a bed at least 235 mm on one side, or 225 mm diagonally. On a 220 mm bed print the plate in two halves with a lap joint (ask for that file).

cross_bar.name: Cross bar (M4 threaded rod + printed spacer)
cross_bar.make_or_buy: buy rod and nuts, print spacer

rear_segment.note: two 65 mm spacers per rod, one each side between the box wall (z 40) and the rear plate (z 105); the box (80 wide) sits between them, so plate - spacer - box - spacer - plate = 2 x 7 + 2 x 65 + 80 = 224

cross_bar.note: Front: spacer = inside distance between the front plates (2 x 41 = 82). Rear: the box sits between the rear plates, so each rod carries two 65 mm spacers (z 40 to 105 each side). Rod = span + 2 plates + 7 each end for washer, nut and 3 mm proud.

set_screws_and_bolts.name: Fasteners
items: pulley set screws, 16 x M4 (not included with MISUMI economy pulleys; M3 x 6 for the stand-in)
8 x M4 nuts and 8 x M4 washers for the 4 cross-bar rods
6 x M3 x 14 with nuts for the hinge sector gears (7 plate + 3 sector + 2.4 nut)

hinge_cross_shaft.name: Hinge cross shaft, 8 mm steel rod
hinge_cross_shaft.note: carries the two hinge pinions across the box, in the 2 spare 608ZZ in the box walls; length to be fixed with the hinge gear drawing

buy_vs_make_rule: Make (print) anything with a shape only this design needs: track, plates with rails, spacers. Buy anything that is a standard part cheaper and better than a print: pulleys, bearings, rod, screws.
_revision: v2, 13 Oct 2026: lanes 20 mm (pulley over flanges), plates 45 tall with bearing bosses, cross bars at 28, sector bolts on R17, axles 230/230/160, rear spacer 210. v1 problems found by the frame check: 0.9 mm pocket wall, spacer fouling the cleat tips, 18 mm lanes. 14 Oct: rear spacers 2 x 65 per rod with the box between (was one 210).

alternative_layout_revB_plates.source: Rev B pack 2026-10-15, plates P1/P2 (Al 5 mm), z converted to vehicle centre line, one side

axles.hinge_shaft: Ø8 h7 plain round shaft (design review 16 Oct 2026: no D-flat, no E-clip grooves; pulleys pinned, TS-11): A 82.3 + B 77.3 (two motors) or one 212 (one motor)
axles.end_axles: none: 4 x ISO 7379 Ø8x25 M6 shoulder screws in the plate slots

alternative_layout_revB_plates.pulleys: HTD5M 20T 15 mm, plain bore, modified: 4 x reamed Ø8 H7 + Ø2.5 cross pin (TS-06), 4 x Ø16 H7 for 2 x 688 each
alternative_layout_revB_plates.track: unchanged (my printed track, 550 loop, 45 cleats); or Rev B stock belt 550-5M-15 with 22 glued cleats
